{{Top|leg}}
'''White Watch''' was the codename for the unit formed by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] [[RC-1140/Legends|Fixer]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] and [[Atin Skirata|Atin]] of [[Omega Squad]]. The pairing was decided by [[Kal Skirata]] during an unauthorized [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|mission]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] terrorist ring.<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>
